feeds.title: ProCopywriters Blog
feeds.description: Founded and managed by copywriters, we exist to elevate the profession of copywriting, provide learning and development opportunities, and help our members showcase their skills, raise their profiles and find work. Explore the blog where UK's largest membership organisation offering info and advice to UK copywriters.

feeds.title: 42courses Blog » Copywriting
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to 42courses. We're a team of curious creatives who found out the hard way that most e-learning was like eating broccoli - you know it's good for you, but it's not that enjoyable. So we built a platform to change that and deliver online learning that's as helpful as an oasis in a desert, and as enjoyable as binge-watching your favorite show. Check out our blog for copywriting articles.

feeds.title: Writeo Blog
feeds.description: Writeo is me turning a love of words into a way of keeping a roof over my head. I have about 10 years of delicious experience as a copywriter, as well as with social media management across the UK and beyond. I have and continue to write everything from newsletters about number plates to blogs about the cost of living, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Meghan Downs Blog
feeds.description: I studied Decorative Arts at Nottingham Trent University and then set up my own Ceramic Art studio in 2015. It may seem like a strange segue, but trust me - it's made me a better marketer, copywriter, and well-rounded person! I resonate with creative business owners. I can use what I've learned to help your creative business to thrive, so you're no longer misunderstood.

feeds.title: Big Star Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: We're a content marketing and copywriting agency that specializes in product descriptions, web copywriting, case studies, and blog writing for holidays, guitars, sunglasses, restaurants, luxury bathrooms, toys, fridges, insurance, stationery, cab rides, and a whole host of other things that none of us could live without.

feeds.title: Chichester Copywriter Blog
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Katy Lassetter and I have more than 15 years of experience as a creative copywriter. I dabbled with the pen from an early age but first seriously entertained the notion of professional copywriting while studying Communication at Bournemouth University. I learned the wonders of SEO and wondrous it is. I also developed an interest in social media marketing - a breath of fresh air but a far leap for the marketing traditionalists!

feeds.title: Blog Write
feeds.description: With over 20 years of experience in PR and marketing involving managing accounts, copywriting, coordinating with designers, promoting events, and managing social media for companies nationwide, I've got experience in the full realm of marketing. My copywriting services have been utilized by companies across various sectors including home improvement, marketing, web development, and interior design.

feeds.title: Bishopsgate Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: Bishopsgate Copywriting is based in Sevenoaks, Kent, and opened in 2010. The company specializes in B2B copywriting and content writing - creating engaging content for businesses of all types and also for marketing agencies. With over 20 years of commercial writing experience, we take on assignments in many different sectors.

feeds.title: Creative Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: We're a copywriting agency with scientists and artists. The science of strategic expertise, our home-built frameworks, AI tools, and sales psychology will get your brand far. Our team of wordslingers combines the power of proven formulas with a creative flair that customers can't resist.

feeds.title: Laurence Blume Blog
feeds.description: I'm one of the UK's most experienced professional marketing copywriters, having begun my professional career in 1981. I've worked solely in freelance practice since 2000, with the 18 years prior to that spent as a Copywriter and Creative Director at some of the top advertising and marketing services companies in the UK.

feeds.title: Jenny Lucas Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: I'm a natural writer who has spent more than a decade translating complex issues and regulations into a concise, simple copy that reads easily and makes good sense. I'm a results-driven copywriter and content writer who specializes in creative words, compelling website copy, and SEO blog content. I've now been writing professionally for more than 20 years and have written about everything from airports to zombies.

feeds.title: Alex Genn Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Alex Genn. I began copywriting at the agency and then moved on to the learning disability charity Mencap. Here I learned the invaluable skill of writing in 'Easy-Read', a unique style of copywriting, which helps people with a learning disability understand complicated ideas. I deliver the freshest ideas, the sharpest mobile app content, super-sticky SEO web content, and must-read, love-to-share blogs that drive click-through.

feeds.title: Editing Edge Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lesley Hussell and my job is to bring some strategic copywriting to your business, so you sell more, inspire your staff, or spread your message far and wide. I write happily in a range of styles and contexts, keeping content fresh and original. I can write with wicked humor or with gravitas when the occasion demands.

feeds.title: DropCapCopy Blog
feeds.description: DropCapCopy is a copywriting, content writing, and copyediting service, owned and run by me, Graeme Piper, a UK freelance copywriter. DropCapCopy is purposely small and I want to stay small. This is how I give every client the undivided attention to detail that's needed for an individual service. Blogs and the latest articles from DropCapCopy. Freelance web and print copywriter for businesses and agencies in Devon and the South West.

feeds.title: Choice Words Blog
feeds.description: I'm Chantelle, a copywriter and a copywriting coach too. Copywriting and copy coaching for entrepreneurs who want to sell their services with pride, personality and confidence! Blogs providing tips, ideas and inspiration for virtual assistants, creatives, coaches and consultants on copywriting.

feeds.title: #1 South Wales Copywriter
feeds.description: I am a freelance copywriter, providing ghostwriting, blog, and website content. I write in a variety of niches, including retail, business, mental health, and entertainment.

feeds.title: Ink Gardener Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Helen Reynolds, a freelance web content writer and copywriter. I live in the beautiful city of York, working with clients across the UK and beyond.

feeds.title: Lemon Drop Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm Julie. Copywriter, editor, storyteller. My passion is for creating copy that really makes businesses stand out and not only gets their message across but does so in words that actually sound as if they've written them themselves. I'm all about authenticity and really understanding the clients' vision for the copy they're commissioning. Here you'll find lots of info on my latest copywriting projects, practical tips to help with your own copywriting skills, as well as finding out a bit more about what exactly it is that makes Lemon Drop tick!

feeds.title: Coast Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Martin. I write copy that people read. And that's rarer than you might think. From website content and blog writing to video scripts and SEO strategies, I have experience across the board. My clients, meanwhile, cover pretty much every sector: heavy industry, small business, tourism, IT, media agencies, airlines and supermarket chains - and many more areas.

feeds.title: Copywriting Bristol Blog
feeds.description: Copywriting Bristol is proud to be a Bristol company owned and managed by expert writer Lawrie Jones. We've been copywriters and content professionals for over 15 years. We create engaging copy and content for businesses, brands, charities, and the public sector. Our content and copywriting experts can provide the words you need to engage audiences, capture customers, and create clicks.

feeds.title: Inspired Copy Blog
feeds.description: Inspired Copy is a UK copywriting agency specializing in SEO-friendly content such as blogs, web copy, product descriptions, and social media captions. We're here to make words work for you because great copy sells.

feeds.title: The Radix Communications Blog
feeds.description: Here at Radix, we've built a reputation for writing successful content for the world's brightest technology brands. We work to support B2B technology marketers worldwide. We write standout content marketing, ABM, and a digital copy to engage, convert, and retain your customer.

feeds.title: Caroline Gibson Blog
feeds.description: I've been a freelance copywriter for over 20 years, with clients ranging from international brands to small businesses looking to become big businesses. Before then, I worked for some of London's leading ad, branding, and design agencies. I'm also lucky enough to have won awards in every discipline.

feeds.title: The Content Ninja Blog
feeds.description: The Content Ninja blog brings you current and relevant information on SEO writing, content marketing and the copywriting world. You'll find 'how to' guides, hints and tips, SEO writing techniques and everything you need to elevate your content marketing.

feeds.title: Pippin Blog
feeds.description: My name's Catherine Every. I've been writing copy for nearly 20 years, so I know what I'm doing. I'll write you the website that will convert more of your visitors. I'll write the leaflet that gets people on the phone. I'll write the corporate responsibility brochure that captures your essence as a business. I'll write you the white paper that demonstrates your expertise. I'll write you the award entry that will bag you that award.

feeds.title: Comma Sense Blog
feeds.description: With more than 25 years of experience working in communications and marketing, Lucy Jackman is a digital copywriter and communications consultant who prides herself on getting it right the first time. She set up Comma Sense through her love of the written word and a genuine desire to use her skills to help other people and their businesses - that's you!

feeds.title: LY Copywriting Blog
feeds.description: We're a talented team of creative copywriters. We provide content marketing services to ambitious businesses. We write words that excite, engage, educate, and entertain. From SEO copywriting to social media content calendars, product descriptions to blog content and more, brands and agencies turn to us for a copy that evokes emotions and converts customers. We're here to help you reap the many rewards of professional, compelling, and creative content.

feeds.title: WriteSpark Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Claire Hewson, the founder of WriteSpark content writing agency. I trained as a freelance copywriter and content strategist. I now help all kinds of businesses to raise their brand profile and successfully sell their products. UK Copywriting blog created by WriteSpark and Claire Hewson, helping you to stay ahead of the ever-changing content marketing and content strategy business.
